abstract.text: In this paper, we will apply the tools from number theory and modular forms to the study of the Seiberg-Witten theory. We will express the holomorphic functions a, aD, which generate the lattice Z = nea + nm aD, (ne, nm) ∈ Z2 of central charges, in terms of the periods of the Legendre family of elliptic curves. Thus we will be able to compute the transformations of the quotient aD /a under the action of the modular group PSL(2, Z). We will show the Schwarzian derivative of the quotient aD /a with respect to the complexified coupling constant is given by the theta functions. We will also compute the scalar curvature of the moduli space of the N = 2 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory, which is shown to be asymptotically flat near the perturbative limit.
